name: Tsuki to Mori to Anata to Watashi
original_name: 月と森とあなたとわたし
source:
Born into a poor family, Charlotte was sold as a slave.

She ran away from home into the woods and found a little house.

Inside the house there was a girl, Mint, who was raised by wolves.

"Are you a witch? A demon?" Mint asked.

These woods were the battlegrounds for fantasy creatures.

Charlotte must choose her allegiance: animal, witch or demon.

Otome Love Adventure Novel Game. Western fantasy. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE098079.html]DLsite English[/url]]
